submission.justification: Mixture-G2 at 2 mm gas gap achieves the best possible time resolution of 0.897 ns across all tested configurations. Comprehensive simulations across the full allowed gap range (1-3 mm) for all three candidate mixtures revealed that: (1) All mixtures perform optimally at 2 mm gap, with degraded performance at both 1 mm and 3 mm; (2) Mixture-G2 consistently outperforms G1 and G3 at every gap size; (3) At the optimal 2 mm gap, G2 provides 32% better time resolution than G1 (1.325 ns) and 55% better than G3 (2.01 ns). The configuration meets all environmental and safety requirements through the planned 90% gas recovery system and HV system compatibility. While G1 and G3 appear to be environmentally-motivated alternatives with reduced fluorinated components, the significant performance advantage of G2 combined with the high-efficiency gas recirculation system makes it the optimal choice for achieving the primary goal of best possible time resolution while maintaining environmental responsibility.
